svg.title: Figure 01 · Value at Risk and Expected Shortfall
svg.desc: Standard normal losses. Shading marks the upper 2.5% probability mass; VaR is 1.9600 and ES is 2.3378 standard deviations. Vertical reference lines are coordinates, not additional density curves.
